Stop scrolling on Instagram Web: hide ads/suggestions, dim non-followed posts, grayscale, Reels timer and stats, Dark Mode.

Better Instagram: Stop Scrolling helps you take control of Instagram Web by removing common distractions and making the feed less “sticky.” It lets you hide low-value sections (ads, suggestions, side panels, etc.), visually de-emphasize content you don’t want to engage with, and optionally track time spent—so you can stay focused when you open Instagram for a purpose.

What it does:
Declutters the interface so your attention stays on what you actually came to see.
Reduces “infinite scroll” traps by hiding or limiting recommended content.
Adds optional focus tools like grayscale and watch-time tracking to encourage mindful browsing.

Key features:
Hide distractions (toggleable):
Suggested / recommended sections
Ads (where possible on the web UI)
Side panels and other clutter that encourages extra scrolling

Focus modes:
Optional grayscale mode to reduce visual stimulation
Dim / gray out non-followed content (where available) to keep your feed centered on accounts you follow
Reels control (optional):
Reels watch-time timer
Basic usage stats to help you notice patterns and cut back

How to use:
Install the extension.
Open Instagram on desktop.
Click the extension icon to open the popup.
Turn features on/off based on your preference—changes apply immediately.

Privacy & data:
The extension runs locally in your browser.
It does not sell data and does not transmit your browsing content to a server.
Any counters/stats (if enabled) are stored locally for the extension to function.

Notes:
Instagram’s layout changes often, so some elements may move or be renamed over time. If something stops working, please send feedback and a screenshot.
Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

Hide YouTube search history suggestions in the search dropdown (does not delete history).

YouTube Search History Hider hides your YouTube search history suggestions inside the search dropdown, so your past searches won’t pop up when you click the search bar.

This is especially useful when you’re screen sharing, presenting in class/meetings, streaming, or using YouTube in public—where you want a cleaner, more private search experience.

Key features
- Hides “search history / recent searches” suggestion items in the YouTube search dropdown
- One-click toggle (enable/disable anytime from the extension popup)
- Lightweight and fast — runs automatically on YouTube pages
- Does NOT delete or modify your Google/YouTube history — it only hides the UI suggestions on the page

How it works
When enabled, the extension detects suggestion items that appear to be search-history entries (for example, items with a “remove” button, a history-style icon, or history-related UI patterns) and hides them from the dropdown list.

Permissions & privacy
- Website access (youtube.com): Required to hide elements on the YouTube page.
- Storage: Used only to remember whether the extension is enabled.
This extension does not collect, transmit, or sell any personal data. No analytics, no tracking, and no external network requests.

Notes
YouTube frequently updates its UI. If YouTube changes the suggestion layout, the extension may need an update to continue working as expected.

Version 1.0.1

Queue follow-up messages and reuse saved prompts on ChatGPT.

ChatGPT Message Queue helps you keep the conversation moving by letting you queue your next message while ChatGPT is still replying.

Key features:
• Queue messages during active responses (via button or Enter)
• View pending messages above the composer
• Edit or delete any queued message before it is sent
• Automatically send queued messages in order after ChatGPT finishes
• Works across ChatGPT Home, Custom GPTs, and Temporary Chat pages

This extension is built to remove reply bottlenecks and improve rapid follow-up workflows for users who ask multi-step questions, iterate quickly, or run high-frequency chats.

Track visited sites, dwell time, new-tab site opens, and the first site after browser startup.

Browser Statistic helps you understand exactly how you spend time online.

It records your browsing activity and turns it into clear, practical statistics, including:
Sites you visited
When each visit started and ended
How long you stayed on each site
The first site opened after each browser startup
What you can see in the extension:

A clean popup with today’s total usage time
A pie chart of today’s site distribution
Top sites today (with “Show more” for additional sites)
A detailed statistics page with period filters: Today, This Week, This Month, This Year, and All Records
KPI cards and charts such as Top Domains, Hourly Activity, Period Trend, Site Open Counts, Recent Visits, and Startup First Site

Language support:
Multi-language UI with 10 widely used languages

Privacy-first design:
Data is processed and stored locally in your browser extension storage
No account required
No cloud sync required for core functionality
No selling of personal data
You can clear records at any time from the extension controls

Permissions are used only for core features:
tabs and windows: to detect active browsing context
alarms: to maintain tracking heartbeat
storage: to save local stats and preferences
host access: to calculate usage across visited websites

Hides account-menu sign-out entries on Google and YouTube pages to reduce accidental sign-outs.

Google Sign-out Button Blocker is a single-purpose extension that hides “Sign out / Logout” entries in account menus on Google and YouTube, reducing accidental sign-outs that interrupt your workflow (re-login, 2FA prompts, lost context, etc.).

Key features
Automatically hides sign-out UI in supported Google and YouTube pages, including dynamically rendered account menus.
One-click toggle to enable/disable protection at any time.
“Disable for 10 minutes” button to temporarily show sign-out entries, with automatic resume when the countdown ends.
Best-effort real-time sync across open tabs/frames so changes apply without manual refresh.

How it works / limitations
This extension does not access or change your account credentials or login state. It only hides matching sign-out UI elements on the page.
If Google/YouTube updates their UI and detection stops working, refresh the page or reopen the tab.

Permissions rationale
Google/YouTube site access: required to hide sign-out UI on those sites.
storage: stores your enable/disable state and the temporary-disable timer locally.
tabs / webNavigation: used to sync state updates across the active tab and frames for immediate effect.

Privacy
No data collection, no tracking, and no external data transmission. Settings are stored locally in your browser.

Reduce YouTube distractions with page-based toggles, multilingual popup controls, and watch-time tools.

Better Youtube: Reduce Distraction helps you customize the YouTube interface so you can focus on what you want to watch.

This extension adds a clean popup control panel with page-based tabs (Home, Video, Shorts, Subscriptions, and You) and lets you quickly turn features on or off with one click.

Key features:
Hide distracting elements such as recommendations, homepage Shorts recommendations, comments, live chat, and other attention-grabbing sections
Hide specific sidebar items and “More from YouTube” entries (including YouTube Premium, Studio, Music, Kids, and YouTube TV)
Separate controls for different pages (Home / Video / Shorts / Subscriptions / You) so settings are more precise
Feature search with direct toggle support (click a result or press Enter to toggle)
All ON / All OFF buttons for fast setup
Today’s YouTube Watch Time display to help users track usage and manage screen time
Multilingual popup UI (10 languages) with translated labels and multilingual keyword matching for more reliable behavior

This extension is useful for students, professionals, and anyone who wants a cleaner YouTube experience with fewer distractions and better focus.

Note: This extension customizes the YouTube interface in your browser and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

Professional video watch time tracking with multiple metrics and historical reports.

Video Watch Time Statistic Pro helps you understand how much time you actually spend watching online videos across websites.

It automatically tracks HTML5 video playback time on regular websites (HTTP/HTTPS pages) and presents your usage in a clear, professional dashboard. The extension is designed for personal productivity, study planning, media habit tracking, and time awareness.

Key Features

1) Automatic video watch-time tracking
- Detects HTML5 video playback on supported pages
- Tracks time while videos are playing
- Works across many video websites that use standard HTML5 video players

2) Multiple tracking metrics (for better accuracy)
- Playtime: counts time whenever a video is playing
- Effective Watch Time: counts only when a video is playing and the tab is visible
This helps you distinguish between “video was playing” and “you were actually watching”.

3) On-page Mini Display Window
- Optional mini display overlay shown directly on the webpage
- Real-time watch-time updates while you watch
- Adjustable position and size (drag/resize)
- Customizable opacity and background color
- Compact mode available to reduce on-page obstruction
- Supports quick “Adjust” mode and ESC to exit

4) Popup Summary (quick overview)
- Today’s total watch time
- Current site watch time (today)
- Recent range summaries (7 days / 30 days / 365 days / all records)
- Site share summary for today
- Quick settings for display and tracking preferences

5) History Dashboard (professional view)
- Watch Time Trend chart with selectable range:
- 7d / 30d / 90d / 365d / All
- Chart granularity:
- Auto / Daily / Weekly / Monthly
- Website Share chart (selected range)
- Interactive chart hover details:
- Bar chart tooltip shows period, total time, and top site
- Pie chart hover highlights slices and shows website/time details

6) Multi-language interface
- Includes multiple UI languages (such as English and Chinese, plus several others)
- Language can be changed from the extension UI

7) Local-first privacy design
- Your watch-time statistics are stored locally in your browser (chrome.storage.local)
- No external analytics, ads, or tracking SDKs
- No watch-time data is uploaded to a remote server in the current version

How It Works (in simple terms)
- The extension detects HTML5 video playback state on webpages you open.
- It aggregates watch-time totals by date and website hostname.
- You can then review the data in the popup and full history dashboard.

Permissions (Why they are needed)
- Storage: save your settings and watch-time statistics locally
- Website access (HTTP/HTTPS pages): detect HTML5 video playback and show the mini display on pages with videos

Important Notes / Limitations
- This extension mainly relies on standard HTML5 video detection.
- Some custom players, restricted pages, or special embedded/iframe setups may not be fully trackable.
- Browser internal pages (for example, chrome:// pages) do not support content script injection, so the mini display will not appear there.

Who is this for?
- Students tracking study video time
- Professionals learning from training platforms
- Language learners tracking immersion time
- Anyone who wants a clearer picture of video consumption habits

Track, measure, and monitor video watch time via a real-time overlay timer with customizable display options.

Video Watched Time Companion helps you stay aware of how much time you spend watching videos online by providing clear, real-time watch-time statistics directly on video pages.

The extension displays an unobtrusive on-page timer overlay that tracks your viewing time and can show different statistics, including:
Time watched in the current session
Total time watched on the current site
Today’s total watch time
Weekly, monthly, and yearly totals

You can freely choose which statistics appear in the overlay through simple toggle controls in the extension’s settings.

For deeper insights, the extension also provides a statistics chart page that opens in a new tab, allowing you to review your watch-time data by site and over time.

All data is processed locally in your browser. The extension does not collect, transmit, or share personal data with external servers.

Video Watched Time Companion is designed for users who want better awareness of their video-watching habits and a lightweight way to manage their screen time.

Auto refresh pages, detect changes, and auto-click selected page positions in order on a custom interval.

Website Auto Refresh helps you keep selected browser tabs up to date and monitor important page changes without manually reloading each page.

Features:
- Choose one or more open tabs as refresh targets.
- Set a custom auto-refresh interval for selected tabs.
- Enable page change detection to compare page text after refreshes.
- Pause automatically when a configured keyword appears on the page.
- Pick a viewport point and click it repeatedly on a custom interval.
- Manage active refresh pages directly from the popup.
- Switch the popup UI between English, Traditional Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian, and Urdu.

Notes:
Page change detection and auto-click work only on pages that allow extension content scripts. Browser internal pages, browser store pages, extension pages, restricted PDF viewers, and some browser-managed pages are not supported. Auto-click uses viewport coordinates, so page layout changes can affect where clicks land. Use auto-refresh and auto-click responsibly on sites where repeated requests or automated actions may be restricted.

Pure black new tab page with a random quote and author in 10 major languages.

QuoteSpark turns every new tab into a clean, distraction-free black page with a randomly selected inspirational quote and author.

Key features:
- Random quote on every new tab
- Smart weighted rotation to reduce repeats
- 10-language support (English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian, Urdu)
- Language switch in popup (no language controls on the new tab page)
- Popup refresh button to load a new quote with animation
- “About the author” action to search the author name in your selected language
- Minimal, fast, and lightweight UI

Why install QuoteSpark:
- Start each tab with focus and motivation
- Keep your browsing experience simple and elegant

Privacy:
QuoteSpark stores only local extension settings (such as language preference and quote exposure counts) on your device. It does not collect personal data, does not track browsing activity, and does not send quote data to external servers.
